written.headline: Chariot launches multilingual TTS model with support for 11 Indian languages
written.summary: Indian AI research lab Chariot launched Chariot-1-TTS-Multilingual, a text-to-speech model supporting 11 Indian languages and English with over 50 voices. The model uses contextual reasoning for pronunciation and supports code-mixing and voice cloning.

written.headline: OpenAI adds API inference residency for GPT-6 Luna in India
written.summary: OpenAI launched an API inference residency in India that lets eligible businesses and developers run GPT‑6 Luna workloads on servers located in the country, with customer content stored locally. The offering addresses data‑localisation requirements, especially for regulated sectors such as financial services.

written.headline: India is now ChatGPT's largest market globally by weekly active users
written.summary: India has become ChatGPT's largest market globally by weekly active users, with the user base doubling since January 2026. According to OpenAI India managing director Prabhjeet Singh, the growth is accompanied by a shift toward enterprise deployment and local infrastructure planning.

written.headline: Lumbra raises $25M Series A for secure AI agent orchestration
written.summary: AI startup Lumbra raised a $25M Series A round co-led by Point72 Ventures and Ansa Capital to expand its secure AI agent platform. The company builds LumbraOS to orchestrate AI agents for the intelligence community and regulated commercial sectors.

written.headline: Radical Numerics unveils Omnii Defense edge AI model for pathogens
written.summary: Startup Radical Numerics announced Omnii Defense, an edge AI model designed to identify natural and AI-engineered pathogens using a laptop and a USB gene sequencer. The model can operate without an internet connection.
